caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an old-fashioned metal candle holder with a wide, shallow, circular base colored in varying tones of dark brown and muted reddish hues. The candle holder has a central cylindrical stem rising from the base, and on one side of the stem, there is a simple, curved handle attached vertically. Atop the stem is a conical candle socket with a wide brim, and a short, partly burnt candle or wick is visible at the top. The entire object, including the base, stem, and candle socket, appears to have a slightly rusted or weathered texture, rendered in different shades of brown and gray, with lighter highlights suggesting worn metallic surfaces. The background is plain and off-white, providing a neutral setting that emphasizes the candle holder as the sole subject of the composition.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
